title: Standard Biotools Dynamic Array 192.24: Load 4 uL
author: Standard BioTools

steps.title: Select workflow and prepare reagents
steps.instruction: Refer to the Standard BioTools X9 User Guide and choose one workflow (Gene Expression with TaqMan assays, Genotyping with SNP Type assays, or Genotyping with TaqMan assays) to prepare the samples, assays, and IFC accordingly.

steps.title: Prepare two sample plates
steps.instruction: Transfer 6 µL of each sample into every well of two separate 96‑well plates.

steps.title: Prepare assay plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 6 µL of assay into 24 wells of a 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Centrifuge plates
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample plates and the assay plate to ensure liquids are at the bottom of the wells.

steps.title: Prepare IFC
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate control‑line fluid to the IFC accumulators as indicated for the selected workflow, then remove the protective film from the bottom of the IFC.

steps.title: Prepare actuation fluid tube
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, add 170 µL Standard BioTools Actuation Fluid (green).

steps.title: Prepare pressure fluid tube
steps.instruction: In a separate 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, add 370 µL Standard BioTools Pressure Fluid (red).

steps.title: Load fluids and reagents onto IFC
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2, sequentially transfer the actuation fluid, pressure fluid, assay mixture, and sample mixture into the 192.24 IFC.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 170 µL actuation fluid to the IFC
Transfer 370 µL pressure fluid to the IFC
Transfer assays (4 µL per well) to the IFC
Transfer samples (4 µL per well) to the IFC
